title: Preparation of environmental documentation
description: We accompany investors from the very beginning, ensuring a smooth transition through official environmental procedures:

blocks.text: Comprehensive support at the planning stage
We accompany investors from the very beginning, ensuring a smooth transition through official environmental procedures:

items: EIA Procedure (OOŚ): We carry out the environmental impact assessment procedure comprehensively, from project screening through the information sheet and environmental impact report to the final decision on environmental conditions.
Environmental expert reports: We also prepare the necessary environmental expert reports to assess the condition of selected environmental elements: fauna, flora and the non-living environment.
Environmental decisions (DŚU): Preparing applications for environmental consent.

blocks.text: Documentation for industry and water management
Documentation for industry and water management:

items: Integrated permits (IPPC): Drafting applications for integrated permits (IPCC).
Water management: Preparation of water law reports and water law notifications, as well as preparation of applications for the legalisation of water facilities.
Waste management: Preparation of applications for waste generation permits and applications for permits for the collection and processing of waste.

blocks.text: We use specialist software to model the plant’s impact on the environment:
Permits for the release of gases and dust into the air, and notifications for installations not requiring a permit and monitoring of emission standards

Preparation of analyses of industrial noise propagation in the environment, and preparation of separate analyses of the dispersion of pollutants into the environment from organised and unorganised sources.
Preparation of environmental reviews and preparation of an analysis of compliance with emission standards.
